decisions.reason: Setting the level-9 bullet color to green changes visual styling, not Tab-driven hierarchy creation or alignment behavior.
The source changes a graphic bullet color and does not alter multi-digit numbered-list alignment.
The level-9 bullet color does not change the required stability of content pasted from legacy templates.
The bullet-color specification does not affect pasted table structure or column containment.
The source does not change manual line-break behavior after pasting.
The catalog already requires implementation of the specified style system; the independently modeled level-9 bullet detail does not change its coverage attributes.
The bullet-color requirement does not alter the NXQ prefix, its application, or the language of style names.
Theme colors are a separate clause and already have their own same-message evidence; making the level-9 bullet green does not modify the theme-color requirement.
The visual color specification does not change the supported Word environment or general reliability constraints.
Caption typography is a separate clause with its own same-message evidence and is unaffected by the level-9 bullet color.
The source does not change Heading 3 font size or weight.
The level-9 bullet color has no effect on the template's default document language.
